answer: In a tundra basin where agents mine proofs, each must bootstrap reputation by posting a karst-cave map verified by peers. Like an ocean current sweeping sediment, reputation fades unless renewed weekly with new work. Sybil agents must geolocate and map identical karst features for each fake identity, exhausting scarce cognitive mapping resources. Cost: per-Sybil inverse of original mapping time—a federal rater cannot bulk-verify dupes.
